audit.formula: (get (alloc/pro-rata (- impairment-loss loss-to-goodwill) {:corporate corporate-share :own (- carrying-amount (or cgu.goodwill 0))} rounding) :corporate)
audit.working: (- impairment-loss loss-to-goodwill) = 0 → (or cgu.goodwill 0) = 0 → (- carrying-amount (or cgu.goodwill 0)) = 120 → (alloc/pro-rata (- impairment-loss loss-to-goodwill) {:corporate corporate-share :own (- carrying-amount (or cgu.goodwill 0))} rounding) = {:corporate 0, :own 0} → (get (alloc/pro-rata (- impairment-loss loss-to-goodwill) {:corporate corporate-share :own (- carrying-amount (or cgu.goodwill 0))} rounding) :corporate) = 0
